feature: Boss and treasure bag reward source tooltips
scope: Runtime NPC and item drop-rate reports establish direct boss rewards and actual associated bag contents. Actual registered reward instances have the global tooltip. Normal/Expert/Master calculation modes verify expanded source names, nonempty native condition descriptions, default four-row truncation and expansion notice. Mixed ordinary-enemy/boss/bag provenance, unrelated-item exclusion, world-cache rebuild and absence of spawned loot/projectiles are checked.
limitations: Drop-rate reporting and direct tooltip hooks, not actual boss kills, bag-opening rolls, physical Shift input, graphic tooltip layout or live reward transport. Source descriptions are not guarantees of availability or drops. Other acquisition paths remain outside this index.
